correctness.rationale: Necessary prefix capacities follow because each copy that emits a later-stage symbol has completed its preceding stage. Consecutive copy assignment of symbol occurrences proves sufficiency. All feasible count vectors have reachable prefixes and successful completions; different vectors force different remaining Parikh vectors. Counting stage-level drops and possible within-stage residues yields the exact elementary-symmetric formula for all positive block lengths and k>=0. Ten independently enumerated finite shuffle languages and 600 finite lattice-vector cases passed; the general claim rests on the explicit proof.

value.rationale: Exact Myhill–Nerode state count for a natural family of concurrent identical stage processes, simultaneously for any number of stages, stage lengths and processes. Unlike mere upper bounds, it identifies the full attainable quotient geometry, exact polynomial growth in process count and a hidden permutation symmetry. The exact all-parameter classification is not merely a numerical substitution or a finite-table calculation.
